contentBlocks.body: A reduction needs an identity value when no elements exist. For addition that identity is zero. Omitting the initial accumulator makes reduce use the first element, and an empty array then throws. A useful regression includes the empty case and a normal case so the fix is not simply returning zero for everything.

contentBlocks.code: export function total(values: number[]): number { return values.reduce((sum,value)=>sum+value); }

contentBlocks.body:

A one-element input hides the missing-identity defect.

**Check your understanding.** Why would a test using only the normal input fail to detect this defect? Write the reason in your own words before opening the solution. Run the additional cases as well as the visible example: the contract boundary 3 case checks a different boundary.

**Transfer it.** Add the regression to a project test suite before applying the fix, observe the failure, then keep it in CI.
